BT Notifier Sync Watch is the app that will help you to find all nearby bluetooth devices .

You can connect to all nearby bluetooth devices and find out all information about peripherals ( UUID , Distance , RSSI , Manufacturer Name , Model Number and much more… )

Smart radar will show you from the closest to the farthest devices to which you can connect .

You can Answer to calls and messages or receive notification via create your own virtual peripherals and connect your smartwatch to your device .

- No more ads.
- Unlimited connection time to nearby peripherals
- Full information about peripheral
